summary: Quhuo Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a change in its ADS ratio from 1:900 to 1:27,000 Class A ordinary shares, effective April 27, 2026. This is a mechanical reverse split (1-for-30) to increase the ADS trading price above OTC minimum bid requirements. No fractional ADSs will be issued; proceeds from fractional sales will be distributed. The ADSs continue trading on OTC Markets under QHUOY with a new CUSIP. The board approved the change, and Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas serves as depositary. This is a routine administrative event, not a special situation.
